content: Ammonnaw lathueng pâphonae
BAWIPA e lawk kai koe a pha teh,
tami capa Ammonnaw kangdout sin haw, ahnimouh taranlahoi pâpho.

Ammonnaw koevah, Bawipa Jehovah e lawk hah thai awh, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, hmuen kathoung hah na khin sak lahun navah, Isarel ram taran lahoi, raphoe lah ao lahun nah, Judah imthung hah san lah a hrawi navah, haha! telah na ti dawkvah,
nang teh Kanîtholae taminaw koe a coe awh hanelah na poe han, nang dawkvah roenae rim a sak awh vaiteh, haw e hmuen koe ao awh han, nange a pawhik a ca vaiteh, nange maito sanutui a nei awh han.
Rabbah kho teh kalauk im lah ka sak vaiteh, Ammon hah saringhunaw a tabonae lah ka coung sak han, hottelahoi BAWIPA lah ka o tie a panue awh han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, Isarel ram thung vah na kut na tambei teh, na khok na pano, a rawknae kong dawkvah, lungthin abuemlah na lunghawi dawkvah,

khenhaw! na lathueng vah ka kut ka dâw teh, miphunnaw koe lawphno patetlah na man sak han. Ram pueng koehoi nang teh na thei vaiteh, hote ram dawk hoi koung na pâmit han. Na raphoe vaiteh, BAWIPA lah ka o tie hah na panue han telah ati.
Moab lathueng pâphonae
Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, Moab hoi Seir ni khenhaw! Judah imthung teh miphun alouke patetlah doeh ao van telah ati awh dawkvah,
khenhaw! Moab khopui e ram, a khopui e khori hah kamceng sak vaiteh, ka lentoe e ram Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon Kiriathaim naw hah,
Ammonnaw hah miphunnaw thung dawk hoi pou panuekhai e lah o hoeh nahan, Kanîtholae taminaw a coe hane ham hah, Ammonnaw hoi cungtalah ka poe han.
Moab ram dawk lawkcengnae hah ka kuep sak vaiteh, BAWIPA lah ka o tie a panue awh han telah ati.
Edom lathueng pâphonae
Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Edom ni Judah imthungnaw taranlahoi moi a pathung teh, a mahmawk lahoi ahnimae lathueng vah, kalenpoung lah yonnae a sak.

Hatdawkvah, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Edom lathueng vah, ka kut ka dâw vaiteh, amae thung hoi tami hoi saring he ka raphoe han. Teman kho teh kingdi sak han. Dedan totouh tahloi hoi a rawp awh han.

Ka tami Isarelnaw e kut hoi a moi ka pathungnae hah, ka pha sak han, Edom e lathueng vah ka lungkhueknae hoi ka lungreithainae patetlah a sak awh han. A moipathungnae pawlawk dawk hoi a panue awh han telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei.
Filistin lathueng pâphonae
Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, Filistinnaw ni ayan hoi na maithoe awh kecu dawkvah, tami thei ngainae lungthin hah tawn laipalah, moipathung awh dawkvah,
Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei, khenhaw! Filistinnaw taranlahoi ka kut ka dâw vaiteh, Kherethnaw hah tâkhawng teh, tuipuipaling teng e kacawie hah be ka raphoe han.
Ka patawpoung e tounnae hoi ka patawpoung lah moi ka pathung han, hot patetlah ahnimae lathueng vah, moi ka pathung torei teh, BAWIPA lah ka o tie hah a panue awh han, telah ati.
